''See also: [[Captain (The Last Horizon) Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The Captain is the leader of the legendary starship known as [[The Last Horizon]]. While rumors once suggested this role was held by a human [[Archmage]] named [[Varic Vallenar]] from the [[Vallenar Corporation]], the position is actually held by a [[Sevenfold Archmage]] who underwent a ritual to prepare for this specific command. The Captain's [[Authority|authority]] is unique; rather than exercising unilateral control, the ship's direction is determined through a collective arrangement involving all six crew members. The Captain serves as a powerful representative and protector, capable of challenging political figures such as senators and planetary governors. This individual has a reputation for significant military feats, including legendary performances in battles like the [[Thevellian System]]. The role is deeply connected to the ship itself, as the vessel possesses a [[World Spirit]] that interacts with its leader. The Captain's status is recognized by the [[Aether]], and their presence or death can directly impact the ship's active state.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The Captain is advised by [[Queen Shyrax|Shyrax]] to select a new crew. [[Horizon]] addresses the narrator as Captain and also refers to [[Varic Vallenar|Varic]] by that title. Additionally, [[Raion Raithe|Raion]] recognizes the narrator as Captain.}}

== History ==
=== {{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|The Captain}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-01-the-captain|The Captain undergoes several rounds of examination before successfully directing the crew and awakening the ship's [[power core]].<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c13">''The Captain'', chapter 13</ref><ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c16">''The Captain'', chapter 16</ref> During these events, [[Horizon]] addresses the narrator by the title of Captain.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c16" /> As the leader of the crew aboard [[The Last Horizon]], the protagonist has been officially accepted as the Captain of the [[The Zenith Starship|Zenith Starship]].<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c21">''The Captain'', chapter 21</ref> The Captain also serves as the narrator for the chapter.<ref name="lh-01-the-captain-c48">''The Captain'', chapter 48</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|The Engineer}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|On the vessel [[The Last Horizon]], the role of Captain carries a significance that differs from the usual standard.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c5">''The Engineer'', chapter 5</ref> Serving as a provisional crew member, the Captain wears a white exercise outfit featuring blue-green highlights and a seven-pointed star on the chest following a re-fabrication of his clothes by [[Horizon]].<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c30">''The Engineer'', chapter 30</ref><ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c32">''The Engineer'', chapter 32</ref> After being advised by [[Queen Shyrax|Shyrax]] to select a new crew, the Captain must contend with the fact that he has failed his crew in previous lives.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c39">''The Engineer'', chapter 39</ref> Despite these past failures, he anticipated the coming ambush and took steps to prepare the battlefield.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c39" /> The Captain's survival is critical to the ship, as his death would cause [[Horizon]] to enter a dormant state.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c48">''The Engineer'', chapter 48</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">7</span></div>
<ul class="wv-fact-list mw-collapsible-content">
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|The position of Captain on [[The Last Horizon]] has a different significance than usual.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c5" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|The Captain is a provisional crew member.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c30" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|The Captain wears a white exercise outfit with blue-green highlights and a seven-pointed star on the chest after [[Horizon]] re-fabricates his clothes.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c32" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|The Captain is a character who has been advised by [[Queen Shyrax|Shyrax]] to choose a new crew.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c39" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|The Captain has failed their crew in previous lives.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c39" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|The Captain anticipated the ambush and prepared the battlefield.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c39" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=lh-02-the-engineer|The death of the Captain would cause [[Horizon]] to go dormant.<ref name="lh-02-the-engineer-c48" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|The Knight}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-03-the-knight|Throughout the journey, several individuals address the narrator by their rank of Captain, including [[Queen Shyrax|Shyrax]] and [[Raion Raithe|Raion]].<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c5">''The Knight'', chapter 5</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c11">''The Knight'', chapter 11</ref><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c14">''The Knight'', chapter 14</ref> It is established that the narrator serves as the Captain of the [[The Zenith Starship|Zenith Starship]], a title also used by [[Horizon]] when addressing [[Varic Vallenar|Varic]].<ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c11" /><ref name="lh-03-the-knight-c28">''The Knight'', chapter 28</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|The Pilot}} ===
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Clad in a mantle and hood, the Captain possesses eyes that blaze with a silver light.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c14">''The Pilot'', chapter 14</ref> During their interactions, the Captain issues a threat to initiate war against the [[Galactic Union]].<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c24">''The Pilot'', chapter 24</ref> The Captain wields a staff to utilize magic, and this implement can be stored within crystal.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c25">''The Pilot'', chapter 25</ref><ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c29">''The Pilot'', chapter 29</ref> Throughout the account, the narrator addresses this individual directly as Captain.<ref name="lh-04-the-pilot-c48">''The Pilot'', chapter 48</ref>}}
